cues: The central theme is duty and its limits.
The community's idea of a good son is ritual and visible: touch the feet, obey, provide.
Varma's idea is personal: listen to me, feed me what I love, let me choose how my life ends.
Rakesh fulfils the first completely, and never notices the second.
